citation.title: The Implementation of a WebGPU-Based Volume Rendering Framework for Interactive Visualization of Ocean Scalar Data

core_mathematical_foundations.continuous_volume_rendering_integral: I(D) = I_0 * exp(-int_0^D tau(s) ds) + int_0^D C(t) * tau(t) * exp(-int_t^D tau(s) ds) dt

adaptive_empty_space_leaping.reversion: Revert to standard dt upon encountering non-zero opacity (A_i > 0)

grid_preprocessing_and_interpolation.trilinear_interpolation: Hardware 3D texture trilinear sampling or 8-tap software blend

non_uniform_depth_handling.strategy_1_preprocessing: 1D cubic spline resampling to 401 uniform layers at 5m depth intervals
non_uniform_depth_handling.strategy_2_runtime_lut: Storage buffer / 1D texture Depth LUT with piecewise-linear interpolation in shader

grid_preprocessing_and_interpolation.spatial_aspect_ratio_scaling: Anisotropic model bounding box scaling with vertical exaggeration factor E_z (10x - 100x)

transfer_function_architecture.1d_transfer_function: 256x1 RGBA8 texture lookup with scalar normalization v' = (v - v_min) / (v_max - v_min)
transfer_function_architecture.2d_transfer_function: 2D texture lookup indexed by (normalized_scalar, normalized_gradient_magnitude) for front/thermocline enhancement
transfer_function_architecture.roi_filtering: Dynamic range thresholding [v_clip_min, v_clip_max] clamping out-of-range alpha to 0.0

performance_benchmarks_and_advantages.webgpu_vs_webgl_speedup: 11.7x faster initial volume loading for ocean temperature fields
performance_benchmarks_and_advantages.fps_advantage: 25 to 40 FPS improvement over WebGL2 fallback on massive datasets (5.48M to 56.7M voxels)
performance_benchmarks_and_advantages.cpu_gpu_overhead: Direct GPU compute and rendering pipelines eliminate CPU-side memory repack bottlenecks
